newsitem.title: UK: Tarmac wins 51 mln stg UK road contract.
newsitem.headline: Tarmac wins 51 mln stg UK road contract.

text.p: British construction group Tarmac Plc said its Tarmac Civil Engineering group had won a 51 million stg contract to build a new stretch of the A13 road in East London from the UK's Highways Agency.
It said the deal included construction of a viaduct of 1.7 kilometres in length.
Tarmac said in a statement that work was expected to start in October and take 2-1/2 years to complete.
The A13 is a major commuter route into London used by many heavy goods vehicles travelling to and from London's docks.
The contract calls for three kilometres of three-lane dual carriageway which will pass through the grounds of Ford Motor Company's plant at Dagenham, east London.
The viaduct will cross Ford's land and three railway lines.
